plotSections.title: Ghosts for Sylan and Gerk, Carlkin for the rest
bullets: Sylan and Gerk take a separate errand, heard as Ghost Cop, while the others go to Carlkin. Ord asks how Gerk is supposed to be bad cop if he cannot threaten anyone. Dana agrees on the conditions of no doors to nothing dimensions, no abyssal monsters, and no opening doors in moving vehicles.
Sylan tells Walker that training has let Gerk manipulate doors a little better, and that he still needs more work.
Sylan sets a regroup at dinner in the castle to plan the next step and does not wait for objections. He tells Gerk it is time to talk to ghosts.

plotSections.title: Elrus will train the mind
bullets: Elrus hears that Gerk needs training and says that makes two of them. He is willing to train Gerk, tells Walker to have the helmet investigated, and says Walker's training can resume after that. He pokes Gerk in the midriff.
Elrus looks remotely half-elf and stands about 5'10" to 5'11". He has an ancient copper-colored dragon. Gerk already knew about the dragon and did not know this height.

Elrus says Gerk is strong of body and lacking in mind, and that they will work that out of him. He calls it no insult: one does not insult an oak as a sapling, knowing it will one day be more. He says the growth he means is in the mind. He says Walker needs help meditating and asks if Gerk has ever meditated.
Gerk asks Ord if he is being insulted. Ord tells him that at least he is strong of body. Gerk does not want to get bigger, because he barely fits places as he is.

Dana explains meditation as being quiet in the mind, like the focus Gerk uses to open a door, because otherwise doors open into the abyss and giant monsters come out. Gerk says that happens only when he thinks about nothing. Dana says the party still needs his rage, channeled appropriately, and that the doors are a separate kind of focus. Gerk thinks raging while opening a door would go poorly. On a seventeen-foot door he only tried to open it harder. Sylan suggests he try it at the next training. Gerk says maybe.

plotSections.title: Carlkin gets a warning
bullets: Sylan asks Dana to notify Carlkin that they are returning today. He does not think they are within five hundred feet. Walker asks why they cannot just walk in. Sylan says last time they had no appointment, barged in, opened a portal to the abyss, and he broke Carlkin's floor, so Carlkin wants warning.

Dana says they are lucky Carlkin allowed another appointment. She had thought he might tell them never to speak to him again. Sylan warns that Carlkin may be wildly hung over and suggests a snack and maybe a lesser restoration, which Ord might perform. Dana says they will figure it out.

Dana Sends that they are heading that way and are not bringing Gerk or Sylan, which she considers pertinent. Carlkin has an opening, and Dana says the Carlkin group needs to leave now. Walker is going with them and is not flying off. Sylan asks Ciri if she wants a door, and she says there is a welcome in there.

plotSections.title: The lantern and the sword
bullets: Sylan borrows the fused lantern-staff from Ord. Ord wants to test whether a different user gets a different effect and agrees to tell him the activation wording. The exact word is not spoken in this chunk. Sylan will take it to Shades and Trades to identify it in its fused state, unless that was already done. Taking it from Ord does not immediately do anything catastrophic.

Sylan wishes he could still use a greatsword while holding the lantern. He has no tail and does not want one. He has heard of a reincarnation spell that left people with tails, and says his appearance has already changed from one experience.

Before going down the vale, Sylan wants to check a place his sword can take him, where he can see spirits like the ones they are after. If those spirits are there, he means to get them out, because it is not a good place to be. He does not think people would want to see that in the open. Gerk does not like the ghosts. Sylan says he will defend him.

chronologicalEvents: Sylan and Gerk split off to deal with ghosts. The others are to see Carlkin. Dana forbids doors to nothing dimensions, abyssal monsters, and doors opened in moving vehicles. Ord questions how Gerk can be bad cop if he cannot threaten anyone.
Sylan reports that Gerk can manipulate doors a little better and still needs practice. Elrus offers to train Gerk and to resume Walker's training after the helmet is investigated.

Elrus, remotely half-elf and about 5'10" to 5'11", with an ancient copper dragon, tells Gerk he is strong of body and lacking in mind, and compares him to an oak sapling. He says Walker needs help meditating.
Dana separates rage from the focus used to open doors. Gerk says the seventeen-foot door was him trying to open it harder, not raging. Sylan suggests he try raging at the next training.

Dana agrees to Send Carlkin before the visit. Last time an unannounced visit opened a portal to the abyss and Sylan broke the floor. The message says Gerk and Sylan are not coming. Sylan warns Carlkin may be hung over.
Sylan calls a regroup at dinner in the castle, takes the fused lantern-staff from Ord, and plans to have Shades and Trades identify it. He then leaves with Gerk to talk to ghosts.
Sylan plans to use his sword to reach a place where he can see spirits and pull them out if they are there, before going down the vale.
Dana says Carlkin has an opening and the Carlkin group needs to go. Walker is with that group. Sylan offers Ciri a door.

Elrus.existing: Walker's hidden ally in the coming confrontation.
notes: He is not named aloud in this chunk. He is the figure already present who takes Gerk's need for training as a second student beside Walker.
He offers to train Gerk, tells the party to have the helmet investigated, and says Walker's training resumes after that. He pokes Gerk in the midriff.
He looks remotely half-elf and stands about 5'10" to 5'11". He has an ancient copper-colored dragon. Gerk knew about the dragon and had not known this height.
He says Gerk is strong of body and lacking in mind, and that they will work that out of him. The growth he means is mental. He says Walker needs help meditating and asks whether Gerk has meditated.
personality: Speaks to Gerk as a student rather than an equal, and treats the criticism of his mind as cultivation rather than an insult.
quotesThemes: You seem to be strong of body, but your mind seems to be lacking. We will work that out of you.
It is not an insult, my boy. One does not insult an oak tree as a sapling. They just know one day it'll be more.
Not pick in here, but pick in there, your mind, boy.

Gerk.existing: Half-orc barbarian, Doorman, and Child of the Great Eldarin Tree.
notes: Door training has improved enough that he can manipulate doors a little better. Sylan says he still needs more work. Elrus intends to train his mind.
He already knew Elrus has an ancient dragon. He did not know Elrus's height.

He does not have a quiet mind for meditation. Thinking about nothing is what opens his doors into the abyss. He thinks raging while opening a door would go poorly. On a seventeen-foot door he tried to open it harder.
He does not want to become physically larger, because he barely fits places now.
He is going with Sylan to talk to ghosts, not to the Carlkin visit. He does not like those ghosts.
personality: Treats Elrus's sapling comment as a possible insult until it is explained, and resists meditation.
quotesThemes: No, that's only if I think about nothing.
I think if I think about raging while I open a door, that seems like it'd probably go poorly.
I just tried to open it harder.

notes: He takes Gerk on a ghost errand and leaves Carlkin to the others. He reports Gerk's partial progress with doors and suggests Gerk try raging on a door at the next training.
He asks Dana to warn Carlkin, cites the broken floor and the abyss portal from the last unannounced visit, and expects Carlkin may be hung over.
He sets the regroup at dinner in the castle.
He borrows the fused lantern-staff, asks for its activation word, and plans to identify its fused state at Shades and Trades.
His sword lets him travel to another place where he can see spirits. He wants to check that place before going down the vale and get those spirits out if they are there.

He has no tail and does not want one from reincarnation. His appearance has already changed from one prior experience. He would like to use a greatsword while holding the lantern and currently cannot.
personality: Treats the ghost errand as his to handle and Gerk's to be defended on.
quotesThemes: Let's go, old Gerk. It's time to talk to ghosts.
My sword lets me travel to another place where I can see spirits like them.
If they are, I need to get them out of there. It's not a good place to be.
openQuestions: What is the exact word that activates the fused lantern-staff?
Are the spirits he is looking for in the place his sword takes him?

Dana.existing: Half-elf cleric and Gatekeeper of the Pitel keystone.
notes: She allows the ghost errand only with no doors to nothing dimensions, no abyssal monsters, and no doors opened in moving vehicles.
She explains meditation to Gerk as quiet focus, like opening a door, and says his rage still matters if it is channeled. The doors are a separate ability.
She Sends Carlkin that the group is heading his way without Gerk or Sylan. She considers that pertinent. He has an opening, and she says they need to leave.

She thought after the last visit that Carlkin might refuse to speak to them again. She says they are lucky he allowed another appointment. She will handle a possible hangover without committing to lesser restoration.
personality: Sets hard limits on Gerk's doors, and treats rage and doorway focus as different skills.
quotesThemes: Please no doors to nothing dimensions. Please no abyssal monsters. No opening doors in moving vehicles.
We need the rage. The rage is the whole thing. But the rage needs to be channeled appropriately and the doors are an entirely separate ability to focus.

Walker.existing: Half-elf dragon rider and fighter bonded to Glimmen, Gatekeeper of The Reach.
notes: Elrus is training him in meditation. That training pauses while the helmet is investigated, then resumes.
He is going with the Carlkin group and is not flying away.
He asks why they cannot walk in on Carlkin unannounced. Sylan answers with the last visit.

Ord.existing: Dragonborn paladin and Gatekeeper of Feldspar.
notes: He asks how Gerk can be bad cop if he cannot threaten anyone, and then tells Gerk that at least he is strong of body.
He gives Sylan the fused lantern-staff to test whether another user gets a different effect. He agrees to pass on the activation wording. The word itself is not said here.
Sylan suggests he might lesser restoration a hung-over Carlkin. Ord does not commit on screen beyond acknowledging the conversation.
quotesThemes: How is he supposed to be bad cop if he can't threaten them?
Hey man, at least you're strong of body.
openQuestions: Does a different user activating the fused lantern-staff change its effect?

Carlkin.existing: Turtle-like person in Langdale, keeper of a lighthouse bookshop in New Navel, who agreed to examine a helm by appointment.
notes: The last visit had no appointment. The party barged in, opened a portal to the abyss, and Sylan broke his floor. He wants warning next time.
Dana believed he might have refused to see them again. He has permitted another appointment and, by the end of the chunk, has an opening.
Sylan thinks he may be wildly hung over and suggests a snack and lesser restoration.
Dana's Sending tells him the visitors are on the way and that Gerk and Sylan are not with them.

Fused lantern-staff.existing: Fused lantern and staff that reveals the Ethereal Plane and draws nearby spirits when the active staff is held.
notes: Ord hands it to Sylan so they can test whether a different wielder changes the effect.
It has an exact activation word. Sylan asks for it, and it is not spoken in this chunk.
Sylan will take it to Shades and Trades to identify it in its fused state. He cannot remember whether they already did that.
Sylan taking it from Ord does not immediately cause a catastrophe.
Sylan cannot also wield a greatsword while holding it.
openQuestions: What is the exact activation word?
Does another wielder change the effect?
Has the fused state already been identified at Shades and Trades?

notes: Sylan says the sword lets him travel to another place where he can see spirits.

He plans to check that place before going down the vale. If the spirits are there, he intends to get them out, because it is not a good place for them. He does not think that should be done in the open.
openQuestions: Are the spirits already in the place the sword opens?

Doorway.existing: Gerk's doorway ability, a supernatural passage between locations.
notes: Recent training let Gerk manipulate doors a little better. He still needs practice. Elrus is willing to train him.
Dana's limits for the ghost errand are no doors to nothing dimensions, no abyssal monsters, and no doors opened in moving vehicles.
Doors open into the abyss, and giant monsters come out, when Gerk thinks about nothing. Dana says doorway focus is separate from rage.
Gerk previously tried to force a seventeen-foot door by opening it harder. Sylan wants him to try raging at the next training. Gerk thinks that would go poorly.

Shades and Trades.existing: Where Sylan found the staff later fused to Ord's lantern.
notes: Sylan plans to bring the fused lantern-staff here to identify it in its new state. He is unsure whether the party already did that.
